cohort: Pregnant women, with a cirrhosis group (n=43) and a non-cirrhosis group (n=172)
finding: Pregnant women with cirrhosis had an increased risk of adverse obstetric outcomes, particularly preterm birth, with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy and total bilirubin identified as key predictors.
mod_finding: Pregnant women with cirrhosis faced increased risks of cesarean section, preterm birth, intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, thrombocytopenia, and postpartum hemorrhage.
